text:
Maria: quick sync — Helios private rollout. Staging smoke failed on egress tests this morning, blocking our canary. Who's owning network + air-gap checklist for customer-side prep? Need owners + ETA.

Chris: I can own network coordination. TL;DR: customer (Helios) hasn't applied the firewall exceptions we sent (outbound to our proxy IPs and port 443) and their NAT gw is dropping keepalives. Asked for confirmation from their infra team.

Jordan: @Chris thanks — can you also confirm we have an egress fallback in the config? If their NAT flakes, we should route to the secondary region.

Chris: Good call. Routing policy exists but not enabled for this customer's env. Code path: `routing.policies.helio -> fallback:us-west-2` in the deployment config. I can flip it after we validate their CIDRs.

Lee: From infra side: our prober results show SYN timeouts to the proxy from their staging subnet. Ran `curl -v --resolve proxy.redwood.local:443:10.5.8.2 https://proxy.redwood.local/health` and got `Connection timed out`. Log excerpt:```
[2026-06-15T09:22:11Z] prober -> 10.5.8.2:443 SYN_SENT
[2026-06-15T09:22:35Z] prober -> 10.5.8.2:443 RST
```
So firewall or intermediary NAT is likely.

Sam: Also a heads-up — airgap media delivery still pending on their side. Per docs we need the v1.4 package + customer checksum to complete on-prem install: docs/private/onprem/airgap.md (see step 3). Priya, can you ping customer success about the package ETA?

Priya: On it. I pinged Helios infra lead (helio-infra@helios.com). They replied they expect to finish firewall changes by EOD PT. I asked for public IP ranges and a screenshot of security group rules.

Maria: Great. Two follow-ups: (1) Chris confirm enabling fallback routing only after we see customer IPs added to allowed list (we don't want accidental cross-tenant exposure). (2) Lee please prepare a quick runbook snippet for oncall if the canary fails — include `prober` command and how to revert the routing.

Chris: Agreed. Will wait for explicit CIDR list and screenshot. ETA to enable fallback: ~30m after confirmation.

Lee: I'll add runbook snippet to the incident playbook and link it here. Draft:```
# Canary egress failure rollback
1) Disable canary ingress: `redwoodctl rollout pause --canary=helios`
2) Revert routing policy: `cfgctl set routing.policies.helio.fallback false --env=helios-staging`
3) Trigger prober: `prober --target=10.5.8.2 --timeout=60`
4) Notify: #eng-platform + @oncall
```
Posting PR in 10m: https://git.redwood/infra/playbooks/pull/523

OpsBot: [deploy-bot] Canary job `helios-staging-canary` scheduled at 2026-06-15T14:00:00Z.

Maria: Thanks. One more: security asked about KMS/HSM for onprem key import — Helios asked if they can use their HSM for disk-level keys. Security team said we support customer-managed keys via KMIP/HSM in private deployments but need an RSA cert exchange. @Priya can you collect their HSM vendor + cert type so security can validate?

Priya: Yep, asked. Helios replied: Entrust HSM v2, supports PKCS#11 and KMIP. Sending vendor contact and cert bundle when they provide.

Jordan: For timeline: if firewalls are applied today and HSM certs arrive, can we aim for a limited canary tomorrow morning? We need a 2-hour smoke window plus a rollback window.

Maria: Sounds realistic. Owners: Chris -> network, Lee -> runbook + prober, Priya -> customer comms + HSM certs, Jordan -> rollout decision. Target: canary tomorrow 10:00 PT, contingency rollback 10:30 PT. Please update this thread when you have confirmations.

Chris: Will update when I get CIDR screenshot from Helios.

Lee: PR up: infra/playbooks#523 (runbook snippet).

Priya: Got the CIDR screenshot from helio-infra@helios.com at 09:45 PT. Forwarded to @Chris. Also received vendor contact for HSM.

Chris: CIDRs look good, added to allowlist on our staging proxy (temp rule). Enabling fallback after smoke pass.

Maria: Awesome — keeping this thread as the single source of truth for the pre-canary checklist. If anything changes, reply here. :thumbsup:
